description: Sixteen jacks gathered into one polyphonic output, in 6HP, with a knob setting how many channels come out

params.text: Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16, and the lights beside the jacks show which of them are in use
Chooses how the inputs are read: Mono takes only channel 1 of each jack, Poly takes every channel of a jack and carries on from there

inputs.text: One of the sixteen signals going into the merge; an empty jack within the channel count contributes 0V and its light turns red

outputs.text: Carries the merged channels, as many as the knob is set to

notes: a light beside a jack is green when that channel has a signal and red when it is counted but empty, and stays dark beyond the channel count
in Poly mode a polyphonic signal in one jack fills that channel and the ones below it, so a four-channel signal in jack 1 takes output channels 1 to 4 and the next goes in jack 5
menu: Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
